text: Code reviews are an important practice in software development. When developers review each other's code, they can catch bugs early, before the code reaches users. This saves time and money because fixing problems later is much harder. Code reviews also help with knowledge sharing. Team members learn from each other and understand different parts of the project better. In addition, regular reviews improve overall team quality, since everyone follows the same standards and writes cleaner code. Although code reviews take extra time, they are worth it. They make the software more reliable and help the whole team grow stronger together.
